data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ahr', meaning 'to protect, to shelter'. Mahrusah is a name given to a girl who is protected and cherished. The name Mahrusah carries the meaning “Protected, Secure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahrusah usually hope their child will grow to embody protected, secure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
